title: Bucks County Playhouse

services.name: Event Rental
services.desc: Support the non-profit mission of Bucks County Playhouse, while having your next event in one of our unique hospitality venues. Whether planning an intimate affair, or a much larger event, Bucks County Playhouse offers 3 different, distinct venues on its historic campus to wow your guest and make your next affair memorable. Opened in 2018 and renovated in 2022, Playhouse Deck offers you unparalleled views of the Delaware River. The restaurant has an upscale, casual vibe with seating in the dining room, bar, riverside promenade as well as an additional section in the Playhouse Courtyard. All areas of the property are available for rental. For additional information, click here. One of New
